gemini-4-argon.note: Gemini 4 Argon, generally available 2026-10-13. agy 1.3.6 lists it as gemini-4-argon-low, -medium and -high, and a round of each seat ran on it on 2026-10-15. Not measured against the native agent yet (docs/evaluations/seats).

gpt-6.1-sol.note: Sol serves the asks that Terra does not reach on the scale of 2026-10-29: Sonnet xhigh (Sol high), Sonnet max (Sol max) and Opus medium (Sol high); the four steps of the ladder are Terra's. The figures are the max row of Artificial Analysis of 2026-10-29, and the table of pairs (config/pairs.json) holds the other efforts. Roles follow plan D4: implementer, supervisor and reviewer; design seats (judge, writer, examiner) are not given because nothing judges what AA does not measure. The models Codex lists and the exclusions are in config/models/harness-models.json.

gpt-6.1-terra.note: Terra serves the four steps of the ladder on the scale of 2026-10-29: Terra low for Haiku high, Terra medium for its correction Haiku xhigh, Terra high for Sonnet high and Terra max for Opus high. Caution: Terra low reaches 15.2 % of Terminal-Bench against 21.7 % of Haiku high, which the rule does not see, and Terra's cost per task is an estimate. The figures are the max row of Artificial Analysis of 2026-10-29, and the table of pairs (config/pairs.json) holds the other efforts. Roles follow plan D4: implementer and supervisor; design seats (judge, writer, examiner) are not given because nothing judges what AA does not measure.

gpt-6-luna.note: Luna max is 1.8 points and 9 code points below Haiku high and is not a starting step on the ladder; Luna medium (18.3) does answer a Haiku low ask (18.6) at US$ 0.011. The figures are the max row of Artificial Analysis of 2026-10-29, and the table of pairs (config/pairs.json) holds the other efforts. Roles follow plan D4: implementer only; design seats (judge, writer, examiner) are not given because nothing judges what AA does not measure.

grok-4.7.note: Grok 4.7 (xAI: built for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work; 500K context; effort low, medium, high, xhigh), checked on 2026-10-13. Artificial Analysis, on the scale of 2026-10-29: 34.3 intelligence at xhigh and 35 at high (it scored 46.4 and 46.3 on the scale of 2026-10-26), so xhigh gives no more points than high and is dominated by it. The harness takes xhigh as it is, and the pairs table (config/pairs.json) holds its low, high and xhigh pairs, which the pair rule judges by their points. The terminal-bench comparisons of 2026-10-13 with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Haiku 5.5 were not read again. models/profiles.json in the plugin's config folder has its profile. grok-4.7-build-fast is the same model on faster infrastructure at twice the token price, billed through the plan: it is not a cheaper lane, and it is left out.

muse-wonder-full-1.0.ownerDecision: «si deja entrar a musewonder full es uno d elos mejores modelos que tiene el harness, ... esta anivel de opus segun yo» (the owner, 2026-10-19). Artificial Analysis names an effort for its only figure of this model, max, which the CLI does not take (low to xhigh), so under rule 3 of the models index it has no figure at an effort it takes; the owner decided it enters anyway, as Opus. On the scale of 2026-10-29 its score at max is 49.7 in intelligence and 0.57 in terminal-bench, against Opus 5.5 at 51.7 and 0.57 at high. On the scale of 2026-10-26 it stood above Opus high (55.8 against 53.6), which is the premise of the owner's words «a nivel de opus»; on intelligence it no longer does, and the decision stands until the owner revises it.
muse-wonder-full-1.0.note: The one model the Muse CLI lists to the owner's account (model/list of muse serve), given by Meta only on the Power and Maximum plans: an account without the plan is refused and the call runs native. Called for real on 2026-10-19 through this adapter (muse 1.4.11): clean, structured answer, the sandbox runs, and two calls at once live together. Its pair, muse/muse-wonder-full-1.0@high, is in config/pairs.json.

muse-spark-1.3.ownerDecision: «muse tambien tiene muse spark 1.3 que es infinitamente mas barato. Porque no se uso a nivel de haiku? considero que es un bug.» and «Dependiendo del effort muse spark 1.3 entra en nivel haiku o sonnet» (the owner, 2026-10-26). The Muse CLI did not list it to the owner's account on 2026-10-19 (model/list of muse serve 1.4.10), but it answered a real call through the adapter that day (specs/008-muse-harness/evidence/real-call.md, docs/handoff/2026-10-19-muse-harness-0.13.0.md) and the owner decided it enters anyway; the CLI lists it since muse 1.4.13 (checked 2026-10-27).
muse-spark-1.3.note: Called for real on 2026-10-19 through this adapter. Artificial Analysis measures it at max only on the scale of 2026-10-29 (intelligence 36.4, Terminal-Bench 0.33; on 2026-10-26 it also listed xhigh, 45.1 on the old scale, which it no longer does), with token price 1.25 / 4.25 USD/M. Cost per task is not in the API and was read by the owner off AA's chart 'Intelligence Index vs. Cost per Task' on 2026-10-26: xhigh 1.1, max 1.3 USD. Spark is not cheap in AA's dollars (1.1 and 1.3 against Haiku max 0.21 and Sonnet high 0.88): it is used because Muse is a subscription whose quota the owner spends instead of Claude's, and within that quota it is the model with the fewest points that is enough. Terminal-Bench 4.0 is weaker than the index suggests (max 33%, against Haiku high 22% and Sonnet high 44%). Its @max pair is measured; @low, @medium, @high and, since 2026-10-30, @xhigh are estimates (the owner's decision of 2026-10-27 and A96, redone on the scale of 2026-10-29), all in config/pairs.json.

muse-wonder-1.0.note: The model Muse itself runs by default. The CLI lists it since muse 1.4.13 (model/list of muse serve, checked 2026-10-27); on 2026-10-19 it listed only muse-wonder-full-1.0. Artificial Analysis measures it at max only: intelligence 43.3 on the scale of 2026-10-29 (52.4 on that of 2026-10-26), Terminal-Bench 0.52, token price 4 / 20 USD/M, cost per task US$ 4.54 (the cost of one task of the index, from its model page captured on 2026-10-26). It sits above Sonnet high (41.1 points) and under Sonnet xhigh (49.6). Added on the owner's answer of 2026-10-27 «Las dos respuestas es lo reocmendado» to the question whether it enters. Not called for real through the adapter yet: a failed call is replaced by the next pair like any other. Its pair is muse/muse-wonder-1.0@max in config/pairs.json.
